project_type: Node.js/TypeScript Express API gateway, monorepo (npm workspaces), Vercel serverless deployment
language: TypeScript (strict: false, target ES2020, module commonjs)
build_system: tsc for build; ts-node for dev; nodemon for watch; no bundler. Root tsconfig.base.json; service-level tsconfig at services/api-gateway/tsconfig.json. tsconfig excludes *.test.ts from build output.
test_framework: Jest 29 + ts-jest 29 already in devDependencies. supertest NOT yet installed — must be added. Existing test files: src/middleware/auth.test.ts, src/middleware/rbac.test.ts, src/middleware/validation.test.ts (all reference @skyrex/shared-types and a slightly different auth.ts shape than what ships today — these may need moduleNameMapper or import adjustments). tests/features.test.ts uses axios to hit a live server (not supertest, not suitable for CI). No jest.config.js exists yet.
verification_instructions: 1. cd services/api-gateway 2. npm test (runs jest) — all suites must pass 3. npm run typecheck — 0 TypeScript errors 4. curl http://localhost:3000/health returns {status:'healthy'} after npm run dev
environment_constraints: App exports `default app` from src/index.ts WITHOUT calling app.listen() — safe for supertest. Pool is created lazily from DATABASE_URL env var; mocking pool at jest module level bypasses all DB calls. JWT_SECRET env var must be set for auth middleware to work (returns 500 if missing). ORS_API_KEY is optional; tracking/calculate-route falls back to straight-line estimate when absent. fireStkPush() in payments.ts is a console.log stub — no real HTTP call to mock.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. README.md describes npm workspaces monorepo. Keep changes within services/api-gateway/ for tests; docs go to repo root. Never push directly to main.
key_patterns: Routes use pool.query() from src/database/connection.ts OR database.getClient() from src/database/index.ts — payments.ts uses the latter. Auth middleware reads req.user?.userId (set by auth.ts which signs {userId, userType}) but rbac.ts and the middleware tests expect req.user.role and user.id — there are TWO auth shapes coexisting; route tests should match the shape used by each route file. supertest tests: import app from '../../index'; use .set('Authorization', 'Bearer <token>'). Mock pattern: jest.mock('../database/connection', () => ({ pool: { query: jest.fn() } })). Use jest.fn().mockResolvedValue({ rows: [...], rowCount: N }).
directory_structure: services/api-gateway/src/ — index.ts (app export), routes/ (25 route files + index.ts), middleware/ (auth, rbac, rateLimiter, errorHandler, validation + their *.test.ts), database/ (connection.ts pool export, index.ts higher-level db helpers), utils/ (logger.ts), types/. services/api-gateway/tests/ — features.test.ts (live-server axios tests, not CI-safe). Repo root: README.md, SETUP docs (various), apps/, services/, packages/shared-types/.
